optimizedDescription.value: Defines resolved install bundles: local/shared files plus target routing, write/remove behavior.

optimizedContext.value:
# Skill Bundle

## Rules
- `ResolvedFile`: `filename:string`, substituted `content:string`, optional `shared?:boolean`; missing/false = skill-local, true = installer-shared.
- `SkillBundle`: `name`, `description`, `files: ResolvedFile[]`, `install(target)`, `uninstall(target)`. Target string ≡ `{targetDir:string}`; `SkillBundleInstallTarget` also permits `sharedTargetDir?:string`.
- Install: normal dir = string/`targetDir`; shared dir = `sharedTargetDir` else normal. Create normal always; create shared only if shared file; write each preserving filename to routed dir; fail gracefully on write error.
- Uninstall: same routing; remove all routed files; absent file no failure.

## Constraints
- File operations belong to `SkillBundle` domain layer (unlike lazy `Skill`).
